senses.gloss: removal, distance. Y. Maas. Sh. I, end, 53ᵃ בר׳ מקום when one lives far away (from Jerusalem, Deut. XIV, 24).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 5:6:5">Y. B. Mets. V, 10ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>קירוב שכר ור׳ הפסד</he> an enterprise in which he who advances the money secures to himself the advantages of profit without the corresponding share in the eventual losses.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:2">Lam. R. to I, 17</cite> (expl. <he>לנדה</he> <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:2">ib.</cite>) <he>לר׳ היתה</he> she became an object of disgust.
